repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until((#Y_Mot).motionSensor_motion == false)
fired = false
}
wait until((#Y_Mot).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Y_Siren).siren_setSirenMode("police")
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` guard instead of a blocking rising-edge wait. The IR requires the script to block until motion becomes true (and then re-arm on false), whereas the candidate only checks the condition at the start of every 1-second iteration, missing any motion events that occur between iterations.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine: a persistent `fired` flag, a block on `not C` to re-arm, a block on `C` to trigger, and the action. This ensures the script waits for the exact rising edge rather than sampling at fixed intervals.
